“The myth of the cataclysm, or the upheaval, is one of the 
oldest tales and is found in nearly every culture. These imagined 
events occurred, according to some Nordic myths, three or four 
thousand years ago. Other legends, notably those told by the 
Shikastra sect of Tibet, date the world changing disaster to as 
recently as 850 BC.”—T . Gliere, The Destruction Myths.
